findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 102 requests to 36 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 5.0 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 2.6 MB (51%) came from third-party domains, 1.0 MB of it from services classified as tracking (52 requests).

15 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), amplitude.com (Amplitude, analytics), crwdcntrl.net (Lotame, advertising), cxense.com (Piano (Cxense), advertising), dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), eu-1-id5-sync.com (ID5, advertising), fastclick.net (Conversant, advertising), id5-sync.com (ID5, advertising).
20 cookies were set by third-party domains (45 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
